intro.title: Make Binder measurable, not invasive.
intro.copy: Ranking quality comes from Binder's own server events. Optional client diagnostics are a separate choice and stay off by default.

diagnostics.title: Optional diagnostics
diagnostics.copy: Useful for load-time and render-failure debugging during beta.
diagnostics.recorded: Fixed screen/event name, duration, small count, success/error outcome, platform and app version.
diagnostics.excluded: Message text, bio/profile text, photos, exact location, contacts, free-form metadata, raw exception messages or stack traces.
diagnostics.retention: Client diagnostics: {clientDays} days · ranking observations: {rankingDays} days

ranking.title: What Binder learns from the deck.
ranking.copy: The server records rank position, shared-interest count, a 10-km distance bucket and later Bind/Pass outcome. Exact coordinates and profile content are not copied into ranking telemetry.

feedback.title: Tell us what failed or felt wrong.
feedback.copy: For an abusive or unsafe person, use Report & Block on their profile or chat. This form is product feedback, not the moderation queue.
feedback.placeholder: What happened? What did you expect instead?

header.title: Clear rules before conversation.
header.copy: Binder is 18+ and built around mutual choice. Before you create a profile, upload a photo or send a message, accept the current Terms & Community Rules and Privacy Policy.

terms.title: Terms & Community Rules
terms.copy: 18+ only · consent · no harassment · no sexual exploitation · no impersonation, scams or block evasion.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.copy: What Binder stores, why location stays private, how safety records work and how to delete your account.
